name: @grafista/dashboard
comment:dependencies: typescript + @types/* live in dependencies (not devDependencies) on purpose: Render deploys with NODE_ENV=production, under which pnpm skips devDependencies at install time. next build hard-requires the TypeScript toolchain (both to load tsconfig `paths` for the `@/` alias AND for its type-check phase) whenever tsconfig.json exists, so these must be installed even in a production install. See docs/deployment-runbook.md §28f.
